title: DR Tulu: Reinforcement Learning with Evolving Rubrics for Deep Research
authors_zh: Rulin Shao、Akari Asai、Shannon Zejiang Shen、Hamish Ivison、Varsha Kishore、Jingming Zhuo、Xinran Zhao、Molly Park、Samuel G. Finlayson、David Sontag、Tyler Murray、Sewon Min、Pradeep Dasigi、Luca Soldaini、Faeze Brahman、Wen-tau Yih、Tongshuang Wu、Luke Zettlemoyer、Yoon Kim、Hannaneh Hajishirzi、Pang Wei Koh
paper_type_zh: 深度研究智能体的演化 rubric 强化学习配方、数据发布边界与反馈审计
best_for_zh: 关注智能体后训练、LLM 评判、检索与引用反馈、数据血缘和可复现实验环境的研究者与工程人员
one_line: Releases SFT/RL datasets, code and checkpoints for a deep-research agent trained with GRPO and search-grounded evolving rubrics, while the final data mixture, online rubric history and evaluator calibration remain only partially disclosed.
DR-Tulu 发布了深度研究智能体的 SFT/RL 数据、代码和检查点；其 GRPO 训练结合检索锚定、持续与演化的自然语言 rubric 以及程序化协议奖励，但最终数据混合、在线 rubric 历史与评判校准仍未完整披露。
why: Makes a long-form, tool-using feedback contract concrete enough to audit: it separates programmatic protocol rewards from LLM-judged rubrics and shows why an open model/data release still needs per-step rubric, source-rights and environment provenance before reuse.
inclusion_reason: An unusually open deep-research training release that exposes an end-to-end SFT-to-agentic-RL recipe, rubric data, tools, code and checkpoints while making the distinction between released static rubric data and unexposed online evolving feedback essential for audit.

title: Problem
问题
html: DR Tulu is curated for the Frontier Reports and Data Disclosure Ledger because it exposes a long-form research-agent record while retaining material release boundaries. A record can contain a question, source identifier, source, question type, conversations or messages, think/tool/answer/cite actions, tool observations, citation fields, and a rubric payload or rollout score. SFT mixes filtered SearchArena/OpenScholar information-seeking queries with HotpotQA, TaskCraft, WebWalker-Silver, MegaScience and PopQA-inspired prompts; RL uses filtered long-form SearchArena/OpenScholar and RaR prompts. SFT trajectories are GPT-5 simulated reasoning, tool calls, outputs and cited answers, whereas RL trajectories are on-policy policy rollouts with real tool calls. The substrate is dr-agent-lib with MCP web/paper search and browsing, asynchronous calls, caching and rate-limit management.

DR-Tulu 被纳入“前沿报告与数据披露账本”，因为它公开了长程研究智能体的记录对象，同时保留了重要的发布边界。单条记录可含问题、来源标识、来源、问题类型、对话或消息、think/tool/answer/cite 动作、工具观察、引用字段，以及 rubric 负载或 rollout 分数。SFT 混合经过筛选的 SearchArena/OpenScholar 信息检索问题与 HotpotQA、TaskCraft、WebWalker-Silver、MegaScience 和受 PopQA 启发的提示；RL 使用经筛选的长程 SearchArena/OpenScholar 与 RaR 提示。SFT 轨迹由 GPT-5 生成模拟推理、工具调用、输出和带引用的答案；RL 轨迹则是当前策略在真实工具调用下产生的 on-policy rollout。其底座为 dr-agent-lib，提供基于 MCP 的网页/论文检索与浏览、异步调用、缓存和限速管理。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The feedback contract is mixed rather than a single verifiable terminal oracle. Search-derived documents seed persistent rubrics; an LM proposes positive and negative evolving natural-language rubrics from the question, sampled responses, search context and the current buffer. An LLM judge scores rubric and claim-support/relevance components. Programmatic components check tool/citation protocol, answer/citation/query format, and valid non-empty search queries capped at three. A final answer receives the composite feedback, but no released objective success predicate resolves open-ended deep-research quality. Supervision is therefore full-episode plus scalar reward, with rubric judgment decisive at the terminal stage.

该工作的反馈契约是混合式的，而不是单一可验证的终止预言机。由检索得到的文档初始化持续 rubric；一个语言模型根据问题、采样回答、检索上下文和当前缓冲区提出正向、负向并会演化的自然语言 rubric。LLM 评判器对 rubric 以及主张支持度/相关性部分评分。程序化部分检查工具与引用协议、答案/引用/查询格式，并对有效非空检索查询按最多三个计数。最终答案获得组合反馈，但公开材料没有给出能判定开放式深度研究质量的单一客观成功谓词。因此，监督粒度是完整 episode 加标量奖励，且 rubric 判定在终止阶段具有决定作用。

title: Method
方法
html: The reported lineage is named prompt sources, LM prompt filtering, GPT-5 SFT trajectories, an SFT checkpoint, real-tool on-policy GRPO, search-based persistent rubrics plus online evolving buffers, then a final RL checkpoint. SFT retains correctly formatted trajectories and exact short-form final answers; prompt quality is scored on a one-to-five scale. Rubric buffers remove zero-variance items and retain the top five by rollout-score standard deviation. RL uses 32 unique prompts and eight rollouts per prompt, a 16,384-token response maximum, at most ten tool calls, temperature and top-p of 1.0, KL coefficient 0.001, token-level aggregation, packed sequences and asynchronous tool calls. The public SFT and RL files are released datasets, but their rows are only a subset of the reported paper/final-run mixtures and do not establish a release of online rubric revisions, tool-result stores or full rollout traces.

论文报告的血缘链为：命名提示来源、语言模型提示筛选、GPT-5 的 SFT 轨迹、SFT 检查点、使用真实工具的 on-policy GRPO、基于检索的持续 rubric 与在线演化缓冲区，最后得到 RL 检查点。SFT 保留格式正确的轨迹及短任务中最终答案精确匹配的样本；提示质量采用一到五分评分。rubric 缓冲区删除零方差项，并按 rollout 分数标准差保留前五项。RL 每批使用 32 个不同提示、每个提示八条 rollout，最大回答长度 16,384 token、最多十次工具调用，temperature 与 top-p 都为 1.0，KL 系数为 0.001，并采用 token 级聚合、序列打包和异步工具调用。公开的 SFT/RL 文件是已发布数据集，但其行仅覆盖论文/最终训练混合的一部分，也不能证明在线 rubric 修订、工具结果库或完整 rollout 轨迹已经发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The evidence bundle verifies the official arXiv record, Ai2 release post, rlrsearch repository and license, author-linked Hugging Face collection, SFT and RL dataset cards, and final model card. The paper reports 16K SFT trajectories, while the public SFT train split has 13,062 rows and explicitly omits MegaScience, HotpotQA and ScholarQA subsets. It reports roughly 9K RL prompts, approximately 5K SearchArena/OpenScholar plus 4K RaR, while the public RL train split has 4,881 SearchArena/OpenScholar rows and explicitly omits RaR. Both public data pages expose only a train split. The final release-level model tree is Qwen3-8B-Base to Qwen3-8B to DR-Tulu-SFT-8B to DR-Tulu-8B RL; that is not a per-record or per-step provenance graph.

证据账本已核验官方 arXiv 条目、Ai2 发布说明、rlresearch 仓库及许可证、作者关联的 Hugging Face 集合、SFT 与 RL 数据集卡，以及最终模型卡。论文报告 16K 条 SFT 轨迹，而公开 SFT 的 train 切分有 13,062 行，且明确排除了 MegaScience、HotpotQA 和 ScholarQA 子集。论文报告约 9K 个 RL 提示，约为 5K SearchArena/OpenScholar 加 4K RaR；公开 RL 的 train 切分则有 4,881 行 SearchArena/OpenScholar 数据，并明确排除 RaR。两个公开数据页都只提供 train 切分。最终模型在发布层面的树为 Qwen3-8B-Base 到 Qwen3-8B 到 DR-Tulu-SFT-8B 再到 DR-Tulu-8B RL；这不是逐记录或逐步骤的溯源图。

title: Novelty
新意
html: For this atlas, the distinctive contribution is not merely an agentic GRPO recipe: it makes two feedback layers inspectable at once. Released static SFT/RL material, code and checkpoints support examination of an end-to-end pipeline; persistent and online evolving rubrics expose why an open release can still have a dynamic-feedback provenance gap. The source roles are construction recipe, data release, verifier/reward and agent environment. The relevant declared uses are SFT, agent training and evaluation. Comparisons should therefore separate released rows and checkpoints from the unexposed online rubric history, judge calls, search observations and selection decisions.

对本图谱而言，其区别性贡献不只是一个智能体 GRPO 配方，而是让两层反馈能够同时被审计。已发布的静态 SFT/RL 材料、代码与检查点支持检查端到端流水线；持续与在线演化的 rubric 则表明，即使有开放发布，动态反馈仍可能存在溯源缺口。其来源角色包括构建配方、数据发布、验证器/奖励以及智能体环境；有证据支持的声明用途为 SFT、智能体训练和评估。因此比较时应把已发布的行与检查点，同未公开的在线 rubric 历史、评判调用、检索观察和选择决策明确分开。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The release does not establish calibration, agreement, version stability or adversarial robustness for LLM rubric and citation-support judgments. The main text names GPT-4.1-mini as judge and GPT-4.1 as rubric generator, while an appendix names GPT-4.1-mini for initial released-rubric generation; an immutable stage-by-stage model/version record is unknown. Zero-variance pruning is not evidence of semantic validity and can preserve search-availability, model or policy-specific shortcuts. Source rights, user-log consent/privacy, crawled-page and retrieved-passage provenance, citation-store rights and a semantic contamination audit are not established. Training documents Crawl4AI and a proxy, whereas current demo/evaluation paths identify other APIs and browser tools; raw observations, cache/rate-limit state and environment snapshots are not pinned. Apache-2.0 for repository/final model and ODC-BY for released SFT/RL cards do not settle rights for every upstream input.

该发布并未建立 LLM rubric 与引用支持度评判的校准、一致性、版本稳定性或对抗鲁棒性。正文称 GPT-4.1-mini 为评判器、GPT-4.1 为 rubric 生成器，而附录针对初始公开 rubric 生成又写为 GPT-4.1-mini；逐阶段、不可变的模型/版本记录仍为 unknown。删除零方差项不能证明语义有效性，也可能保留检索可得性、模型偏差或特定策略捷径。来源权利、用户日志同意/隐私、爬取网页和检索段落的溯源、引用库权利以及语义污染审计均未建立。训练文档使用 Crawl4AI 和代理，而当前 demo/评估路径使用其他 API 与浏览器工具；原始观察、缓存/限速状态和环境快照均未固定。仓库/最终模型的 Apache-2.0 以及公开 SFT/RL 数据卡的 ODC-BY 也不能解决所有上游输入的权利问题。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Evidence-backed uses are SFT, agent training and evaluation within the stated released-artifact boundary. The Card supports comparison of tool-trajectory schemas, a composite feedback contract, rollout configuration and visible SFT/RL release scope with another entry. It can also prevent an erroneous inference that the public files reproduce the paper's whole training mixture or that static released rubrics reproduce online evolving feedback. It does not authorize reuse of omitted subsets, RaR material, user interactions, crawled search results, teacher outputs, undeclared citations or unreleased rollout/rubric histories.

有证据支持的用途仅限在已说明的发布工件边界内进行 SFT、智能体训练和评估。本卡可用于与其他条目比较工具轨迹模式、组合反馈契约、rollout 配置和可见的 SFT/RL 发布范围；它也可避免错误地把公开文件当作论文完整训练混合，或把静态公开 rubric 当作在线演化反馈的复现。它不授权复用被省略的子集、RaR 材料、用户交互、爬取的检索结果、教师输出、未声明的引用或未发布的 rollout/rubric 历史。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Trace unit to inspect: question/source metadata, think-tool-answer-cite trajectory, tool observations, rubric payload and rollout score.
  • Release boundary to verify: public SFT has 13,062 rows versus 16K reported trajectories; public RL has 4,881 SearchArena/OpenScholar rows and omits final-run RaR.
  • Feedback contract to verify: LLM-judged persistent/evolving rubrics and citation support plus programmatic protocol, format and capped-query rewards.
  • Reuse gate before relying on results: obtain per-step rubric/judge lineage, rollout and tool-result logs, source-rights evidence, a split/contamination audit and a pinned environment.

• 应核查的轨迹单元：问题/来源元数据、think-tool-answer-cite 轨迹、工具观察、rubric 负载和 rollout 分数。
  • 应核查的发布边界：公开 SFT 有 13,062 行而论文报告 16K 条轨迹；公开 RL 有 4,881 行 SearchArena/OpenScholar 数据并省略最终训练的 RaR。
  • 应核查的反馈契约：LLM 判定的持续/演化 rubric 与引用支持度，加上程序化协议、格式和封顶查询奖励。
  • 依赖结果前的复用门槛：获得逐步骤 rubric/评判血缘、rollout 与工具结果日志、来源权利证据、切分/污染审计以及固定的环境。
